artifact: AR-QA: architect ruling on QA findings SEC-001 and TEST-001 for STUDIO-OBS-013 (guided learning-run video recording)
author: @architect (Aria)
mode: static read only. Root holds the S4 frozen-identity window, so no code, test or contract was edited and no build or test was run. Line numbers are from the working tree on HEAD 734ad704f.
verified: studio-runner/src/run/browser.ts:540-546 (guided). launchPersistentContext({recordVideo: {dir: recording.dir}}), then page = context.pages()[0], then video = page.video(), then recording.ready(video !== null), and only after that verifyBrowserPreferences(page, profile). So the run origin and the recorded file both cover the probe.

studio-runner/src/run/browser.ts:58-72 (verifyBrowserPreferences). The probe navigates the page to chrome://version/ (reads #profile_path and #executable_path) and to chrome://prefs-internals/ (reads the effective preference JSON), then to about:blank.

studio-runner/src/run/browser.ts:150-161 (replay, observedScope). The replay path does: startupVideo = page.video(); verifyBrowserPreferences; page.close(); startupVideo.path(); realpath, lstat, no-symlink and same-directory checks; startupVideo.delete(); readdir(videoDir) is empty, otherwise RECORDING_FAILED; page = context.newPage(); page.url() === 'about:blank', otherwise TARGET_DRIFT. The app video is the new page's video (:210).

studio-runner/src/run/childRuntime.ts:185-192 (replay). takeRunOrigin is called only after the launch has returned the fresh app page, after the startup video was deleted and the app video path was validated. So in replay, offset 0 = the app page's recording, not the probe.

studio-runner/src/guided/evidence.ts:108-112, 170-181. The per-session evidence directory is a fresh mkdtemp (checks-recording-*), and ready() takes the single origin through takeRunOrigin. Nothing in evidence.ts needs to change.

backend GuidedRecordingTimings.java:22-31, 60, 128. The backend derives step items as min(startMs) over each step's action items. Runner timings are action-only (studio-runner/src/guided/evidence.ts:137-139).
studio-runner/test/fixtures-tier/guided-recording.test.ts:92 already asserts that request.dir holds exactly one file mid-session. It is the R13 host for the SEC-001 oracle.

GuidedPublicationReplayIT.java:852-853 configures studio.execution.video-store.provider=local at TEMP/objects. :16091-16093 points the guided worker (STUDIO_RUNNER_OBJECT_STORE_DIR) at the same directory. :13088-13100 decodeJoinedVideo asserts that ffmpeg is on PATH (isNotNull: it fails, it does not skip). :16024-16036 is the replica check: a separate app with no recording store, which asserts isIn(UNAVAILABLE, PROCESSING).

GuidedPublicationReplayIT.java:3758 actualSecretLoginPublishesValueFreeAndTwoOrdinaryRunsResolveFreshWithoutModel is the joined OBS-007 login-fixture learn run: startLearning, awaitFinalizing, finalize, then two ordinary replays whose videos are decoded at :3990-4051. The class already wraps chromium.launchPersistentContext inside the guided worker (p3GuidedLaunchCounter).

grounds: Replay closed this exposure deliberately (browser.ts:150-161), so the guided path regresses an established control.

What is exposed: the runner's scratch profile path, executable path, command line, Chromium version and effective preference JSON. That is runtime reconnaissance. It is streamed or downloaded by every CSI reader and kept for studio.execution.evidence-retention.

No secret is shown, and the footage lasts about 0.6 s (R13 R-1 estimate; QA corroborated it only indirectly through a first-action startMs of 582, and nobody decoded a frame). That supports MEDIUM, not a waiver: the fix is about ten lines of reuse, with no contract, schema or backend change.
SEC001.amendsAR1: AR-1 R4 decision text ('BEFORE verifyBrowserPreferences') is AMENDED. Guided recording-context readiness is now the replay instant: the fresh app page exists after the startup video was deleted (replay childRuntime.ts:191 semantics). Unchanged: one origin per session, takeRunOrigin plus STUDIO_RUNNER_SEEK_ORIGIN_CALIBRATION_MS, no performance.now() default, OBS-015 prefix replay stamps with the same session clock, and nothing on the wire.

change.owner: R13 (@dev, runner lane). B13 is not needed: there is no backend, contract, V20 or pin change.

files.edit: Only when `recording` is present, reuse the replay sequence from browser.ts:153-160 verbatim in order: (1) startupPage = context.pages()[0] ?? await context.newPage(); startupVideo = startupPage.video(). If it is null, call recording.ready(false) and continue down the existing unrecorded path (the existing recorder-fault semantics). (2) preferenceEvidence = await verifyBrowserPreferences(startupPage, profile). (3) await startupPage.close(). (4) path = await startupVideo.path(), with the same realpath/lstat checks, except that the expected directory is realpath(recording.dir), not scratch/video. Require: not a symlink, a regular file, and dirname(realpath(path)) === realpath(recording.dir). (5) await startupVideo.delete(); then (await readdir(recording.dir)).length === 0. (6) page = await context.newPage(); page.url() === 'about:blank', otherwise throw TARGET_DRIFT. (7) video = page.video(); recording.ready(video !== null). That is the origin, and it is the last statement before the existing listener, route and CDP setup at :548ff. `page` and `video` must be bindings to the NEW page. The CDP session, crash listener, route, blank proof, handle.page and recordedVideo() all run after the change and must see the new page. If recordedVideo kept the startup handle, every guided recording would upload a deleted file and read UNAVAILABLE. Without `recording`, the path stays byte-identical to today (probe on the single page, no close or newPage).
Restate readiness: 'after the startup probe recording is deleted and the fresh app page exists (replay semantics, AR-QA SEC-001)'. Docs only.

change.failureSemantics: [AUTO-DECISION] What happens when the startup-video checks or delete fail (step 4/5 throws)? Fail closed, as replay does: throw RECORDING_FAILED inside the existing try, so the existing GuidedLaunchFailure cleanup path ends the launch. Reason: degrading to ready(false) would leave a chrome:// file in the evidence directory until settlement and needs a new branch. Replay's precedent is fail-closed. A local unlink failure is environmental and rare. Trade-off: a guided launch can now fail where it used to succeed. Accepted. This is NOT the AC-6 'recorder fault mid-session' case, which must still be injected after readiness.
change.notChanged: No boundedStartup or deadline is added. The guided path has none today, the probe is already unbounded, and adding one would touch OBS-009 P3's startup bound (AR-1 SC-3). disposeScratch and the evidence-directory ordering are untouched, so SC-3 is not tripped. No BootstrapPageGuard is added: the guided extra-page listener already registers after this block. evidence.ts, the manifest, the upload, V20, openapi.yaml, the schemas, StudioContractTest and confinement BASE_SHA256 are all unchanged.
change.effectOnStepOffsetsAndSeek: Every action startMs/endMs, and so every backend-derived step offset (min over the step's actions), drops by Δ = the probe duration (about 0.6 s, inferred from R-1). The video loses the same Δ from its head, because the uploaded file is the new page's recording, which starts at newPage. Clock zero and video zero move together, so seek alignment is preserved, and is tighter than today, because the origin now sits next to the recorded page's creation, exactly as in replay. Bounds still hold: startMs ≥ 0, and scaleGuard ≤ maxSessionSeconds × 1000 has Δ more headroom. Video duration shortens by Δ. No wire shape changes.
change.frozenIdentity: browser.ts is one of the 32 files in QA's worktree digest. Landing this fix changes the identity, so root must re-freeze, rebuild studio-runner/dist (untracked) and re-run the runner tiers and the joined IT on the new identity. The fix should land before the S4 run rather than being waived around it.

proofOracles.lane: R13, runner fixtures tier, studio-runner/test/fixtures-tier/guided-recording.test.ts. Extend the happy-path 'records the persistent context…' case (:109). No new framework: it decodes with ffmpeg and ffprobe exactly as test/fixtures-tier/observed-bootstrap-video.test.ts:41-42 and observed-bootstrap-process-tree.test.ts:47 already do. ffmpeg must be present. If it is absent the test FAILS. It is never skipped.
proofOracles.A_startupFramesAbsent: Take the uploaded objects/studio/fixture-csi/guided/{sessionId}.webm and let a0 = the first action timing's startMs (the navigate). Decode at FULL resolution, not with scale=1:1 (replay's own JSON admits that the area-scaled predicate does not establish diagnostic-frame absence): ffmpeg -v error -i <webm> -t <a0/1000> -pix_fmt rgb24 -f rawvideo pipe:1. Assert length > 0 and every byte ≥ 245, meaning every frame before the first action is blank white. On today's tree this is RED: chrome://version and prefs-internals text fall inside [0, ~582 ms).
proofOracles.B_trimBeforeOffsets: Let t1 = the best_effort_timestamp_time (ffprobe -show_frames) of the first decoded frame with any byte < 245, which is the login fixture's first paint. Assert -250 ≤ t1 − a0 ≤ 500. The upper bound is the replay seek budget (§6.4, observed-bootstrap-video.test.ts). The lower bound catches the half-fix mutant (startup video deleted, but ready() still taken before the probe), where t1 − a0 ≈ −Δ ≈ −600. Record a0, t1 and the frame count in docs/qa/evidence/STUDIO-OBS-013/r13/ (the same ledger).
proofOracles.C_structural: Keep :92 (exactly one file in request.dir mid-session). Add, in the AC-1 parity case (:147-168): ready === 1, and guided.handle.page.url() === 'about:blank' before the first navigation. Also assert that recordedVideo() resolves to a path whose basename is the single file left in request.dir before close.
proofOracles.status: Not run (frozen window). Show A red on the current tree and green after the fix. Report a skip as a skip.

TEST001.verdict: Upheld HIGH. AC-6 has no joined proof today. GuidedPublicationReplayIT:16036 isIn(UNAVAILABLE, PROCESSING) is not AC-6 evidence and is not an oracle.
TEST001.owner: root S3/S4 joined-proof lane (@dev). Test-only change in GuidedPublicationReplayIT. No backend main change.
TEST001.infrastructure: Use only what the class already has: Testcontainers PostgreSQL; the real backend; the guided worker node process (guidedMain via p3GuidedLaunchCounter) on real Chromium (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH); the filesystem object store at TEMP/objects, shared by the backend (provider=local) and the worker (STUDIO_RUNNER_OBJECT_STORE_DIR); decodeJoinedVideo, which asserts ffmpeg is on PATH and fails if it is not; and the existing sink scanner (collectJoinedSinks / sinkBytes). Precondition: studio-runner/dist is rebuilt from the frozen identity (including the SEC-001 fix). A missing ffmpeg or Chromium is an environment FAIL, reported as such and never as a pass.

happyPath.host: Extend actualSecretLoginPublishesValueFreeAndTwoOrdinaryRunsResolveFreshWithoutModel (:3758). It is the OBS-007 login-fixture learn run, and its two ordinary replays already decode their videos (:3990-4051). That makes it the regression half of AC-6 in the same method.
asserts: 1. After finalize, poll GET /api/v1/studio/guided-sessions/{id}/result with a bound (≤45 s, the p3DecodeVideo pattern, inside settle-grace PT2M) until evidence.video.status != PROCESSING. Then assert isEqualTo("AVAILABLE") and partial == false. No isIn.

2. V20 fact: SELECT state, partial, video_key, manifest_key, timings::text FROM studio_guided_session_recordings WHERE session_id=? returns exactly one row, with state AVAILABLE and expires_at not null. video_key equals GuidedRecordingKeys.derive(csi, id) videoKey, so the backend and runner derivations agree.

3. File: TEMP/objects.resolve(video_key).normalize() is under TEMP/objects, is a regular file, is not a symlink, has size > 0, and starts with the WebM header 1A45DFA3. decodeJoinedVideo(...) gives decodedFrames > 0.

4. Authenticated range read: GET /api/v1/studio/guided-sessions/{id}/video with the session cookie and Range: bytes=0-1023 returns 206, with Content-Range 'bytes 0-1023/{fileSize}' and a body byte-equal to the file's first 1024 bytes. Negative: the same request without a cookie gets the existing unauthenticated envelope (not 200 or 206).

5. Offsets: from result.actionTimings, the set of kind=action items' admissionIds equals the set of dispatched admissions in studio_guided_actions for the session (the ledger the class already parses at :1820-1830; dispatched = dispatchCount 1). The counts are equal (AR-1 auto-decision 5: equality on the happy path). The kind=step item count equals the distinct step_id count over those actions. Each step's startMs equals the min startMs of its actions. Every startMs is ≥ 0 and ≤ maxSessionSeconds × 1000. The list is sorted per R2. The V20 timings text equals the served actionTimings verbatim.

6. Manifest: TEMP/objects.resolve(manifest_key) exists and parses, with evidenceState AVAILABLE. Add the manifest bytes, the V20 timings text and the /result body to sinkBytes, so the existing canary scan (raw, URL-encoded and base64 forms of the password canary) covers them with zero hits. The /result body and /video headers contain no video_key, manifest_key, bucket or endpoint.
7. Regression: the two ordinary replay videos keep their existing assertions (AVAILABLE, 206, decoded). The guided video_key is not among the replay videoKeys.

recorderFault.host: A new sibling @Test in the same class that reuses startLearning and awaitFinalizing on the same login fixture. No new class and no new framework.
recorderFault.injection: Use the existing worker hook. Extend p3GuidedLaunchCounter's launchPersistentContext wrapper to write args[1].recordVideo.dir into the TEMP control JSON it already maintains. After the first dispatched action is committed (the vault read count or ledger row the method already awaits) and before the session ends, the test deletes every file in that directory. This is the same recorder-side fault as runner recorderFileLost (guided-recording.test.ts:92), not a store fault (AR-1 negativeTestExpectations runner_R13_R14/3).
asserts: The session still reaches its terminal or finalizable state, as the existing awaitFinalizing/finalize path asserts.
The V20 row has state UNAVAILABLE, partial false and timings [].
result.evidence.video.status isEqualTo("UNAVAILABLE") and actionTimings is empty.
Files.notExists(TEMP/objects/video_key). The manifest exists with evidenceState UNAVAILABLE. This means there is no fake video.
Discrimination: the store is configured in this class and the happy-path test proves AVAILABLE under the same configuration, so UNAVAILABLE here can only come from the injected fault.

TEST001.line16036: Keep the replica check, but make it deterministic. First read the V20 row for that session from the shared database. If a row exists, assert isEqualTo("UNAVAILABLE") (no store on the replica, per ARCH-001(c)). If no row exists, assert isEqualTo("PROCESSING") inside the settle window. Do not count it as AC-6 evidence.
TEST001.status: Not written and not run (frozen window). S4 reports counts per method, and reports skips as skips.
